scope: Independent read-only audit of temporal pattern features; no detector inference

raw_recalculation.method: Independent direct overlap dot-products at interpolated lags, with fresh waveform FFT/front-end calculation; never called analyze_patterns features or normalized_acf

time_alignment.assessment: Formula direction is correct. Duration-based mismatch reaches about 0.54%; around a 2 s original lag this is about 11 ms in original-time units. FFmpeg transient offsets up to 32 ms were previously recorded; peak lag at 10 ms grid is sensitive to these shifts.

interpretation.finding: The 1.25-rate envelope change shares direction for human and F5-TTS, but YourTTS changes in the opposite direction; no universal AI-specific sign emerges. Some spectral shifts are comparable to the processed 1.0 control. Synthetic repeated-motif checks demonstrate sensitivity to repetition, not deepfake discrimination.

cautions: These 64 previously explored recordings and generator families are exploratory; speaker independence is unverified.
The 1.0 atempo control changes the waveform, so processing artifacts must be considered.
Within-recording autocorrelation can reflect speech rhythm, recording conditions or transform artifacts; no breath event is annotated.
No GPU detector scores, EER, ADS or official score are part of this pattern analysis.
